item.title: Rome: Jewish tourist attacked twice in 24 hours
item.description: Yitzhak Dahan from Paris, who was visiting Rome on a family vacation, was pepper-sprayed near the Jewish Ghetto and, less than 24 hours later, was attacked by four unidentified individuals.

item.title: Bank of Jerusalem CEO to employees: No connection between Mali Yahalomi's disappearance and the bank
item.description:
CEO of the Bank of Jerusalem, Yair Kaplan, where Mali worked, addressed employees in a letter regarding her disappearance. According to him, "Other than the fact that she is a bank employee, no connection has been found between the incident and the bank."
Kaplan emphasized that a gag order has been imposed on the incident and that it is forbidden to share information about the case.

item.title: Before the Word: Beethoven, the Shofar, and the Living Melody
item.description: The shofar does not teach what we never knew. It awakens what we have allowed ourselves to forget. Every generation sings the same nusach in prayer, yet no generation sings it in exactly the same way. It becomes a living thing.

item.title: Iranian President Pezeshkian meets incoming Basij commander
item.description:
Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian met with Hossein Taeb, who was appointed commander of the Basij organization of the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC). During the meeting, Pezeshkian congratulated Taeb on his appointment.
Taeb, who previously served as head of the IRGC's Intelligence Organization and as commander of the Basij during the suppression of the 2009 protests, was appointed to the position by order of Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei, following the death of the previous commander, Gholam-Reza Soleimani.

item.title: Gag order imposed on investigation into disappearance of Mali and Liel Yahalomi.
item.description:
The family of Mali and Liel Yahalomi has pushed back against police briefings regarding their disappearance, saying there is no evidence to rule out a nationalistically motivated terror attack.
The family said they provided Lahav 433 investigators with all information in their possession and warned that some reports about the case contradict information they have received.

item.title: Jewish business leaders Josh Kushner and Bob Iger to buy LA Lakers for record $12.5B
item.description: Jewish investors Joshua Kushner and Bob Iger agree to acquire the LA Lakers for a record $12.5 billion, subject to NBA approval.

item.title: Hamas announces intention to run in PA elections
item.description: Terror group Hamas announces plans to participate in upcoming PA legislative elections, opposing pre-conditions and aiming to challenge Fatah's political control.

item.title: Erdogan accuses Israel of trying to 'erase' Palestinian issue
item.description: Turkish President Erdogan meets PA chairman Mahmoud Abbas in Ankara, accusing Israel of exploiting regional turmoil and pledging support for Palestinian statehood.

item.title: Report: US officials questioned Israeli intelligence behind Trump’s clandestine flight
item.description: According to The Washington Post, US Intelligence officials doubted Israeli reports of an Iranian plot against Trump, but a covert plane swap was executed out of extra caution.

item.title: Grand jury indicts Nick Reiner for murder of parents
item.description: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty after a grand jury indicts him on murder charges for the fatal stabbing of his parents, Rob and Michele Singer Reiner.

item.title: Report: Four nations shortlisted to oversee Hezbollah disarmament
item.description: According to Reuters, Israel and Lebanon have agreed on four nations - Britain, Italy, Switzerland, and Indonesia - as potential foreign observers to verify Hezbollah's disarmament.

item.title: Huckabee: Trump is willing to 'bankrupt' Iran
item.description: Speaking on Newsmax, US Ambassador Mike Huckabee praises Secret Service agents and Mossad intelligence for thwarting Iranian threats against President Trump.

item.title: Colombia: Earthquake death toll rises to 265, hundreds still missing
item.description:
The death toll from the powerful earthquake that struck Colombia has risen to 265.
Additionally, at least 496 people remain listed as missing as search and rescue operations continue.

item.title: Alleged non-response to terrorist exercise: Likud and IDF respond to Liberman
item.description: Likud issues sharp response to Yisrael Beytenu chairman after he claimed that dozens of Nukhba terrorists practiced a raid on an Israeli community and that political leadership prevented the IDF from taking action.
